runtimeSupport.scope: GC9107 版 128×128 SPI/RGB565、GPIO/LEDC 低有效背光、普通呼吸灯、BOOT，以及 CST816T 单点轮询/状态变化中断已建模；ST7735、手势中断、充电器和 IMU 未实现，完整出厂固件未验证。
unsupported: Factory images have not been downloaded, executed or validated. Board/MMIO tests do not establish full factory compatibility.
Latest ST7735 display replacement, MCU V1.0/V1.1 charger variants and battery backboard variants are not silently substituted.

GC9107 subset accepts 16-bit RGB565, DCS windows, four official rotations, BGR, IPS polarity, sleep/on/off and reset. RGB444/RGB666, readback IDs, off-screen RAM, scrolling, tearing, gamma/voltages and calibrated optical behavior are unmodeled.
SPI controller transport is used; bit-banged SPI and nine-bit command/data framing are unsupported.

CST816T default IRQ mode is conservatively disabled until configured. FAh.EnChange emits documented EDh pulse widths, with deterministic immediate stimulus handling; physical scan/debounce timing is not calibrated. Gesture, periodic/test IRQ, auto sleep/reset and identity registers are unmodeled; unknown reads NACK instead of inventing chip IDs.

Official factory initialization requests FAh.EnMotion gesture IRQ. This subset accepts that configuration but does not synthesize gesture events, so a firmware that only polls on gesture IRQ will not receive touch reports until it enables supported contact-change IRQ or polls directly.
SGM41562/ETA4662 charger, LSM6DSL IMU, battery divider/ADC and PMIC power sequencing are unmodeled; their I2C addresses remain absent.

PWM observation reuses existing LEDC static latched duty. Hardware fade sequences, per-edge optical brightness, electrical contention between BOOT and LED GPIO9, battery state and radio behavior are unverified.
runtimeSupport.firmwareCompatibility: No factory image is claimed working by a board protocol test.

conflicts.resolution: Wiki says 4 MB PSRAM; exact board README says not fitted and the ESP32-C6 does not support it. Allocate 0 MB PSRAM.

Wiki calls the LED WS2812 and current README calls it RGB/one-wire; MCU V1.2 schematic has an ordinary two-terminal LED/resistor to GPIO9, and official examples use low-active LEDC PWM. Model one ordinary brightness output, not RMT/WS2812. Emission color was not calibrated; neutral white is a visualization choice.
README explicitly distinguishes earlier GC9107 from latest ST7735. This profile selects GC9107; ST7735 has offsets 2/3/2/3 and is not aliased to this controller.

Datasheet describes 128-column controller RAM, while the exact vendor driver uses CASET2..129 for its 128-pixel glass. Implement a documented visible-window subset by normalizing the four driver-defined offsets before standard DCS pixel placement; do not invent 132-column physical GRAM or claim undocumented off-screen behavior.
